verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an experimentation product: multivariate A/B/n flags, events collected into a managed warehouse, and results read through a built-in Bayesian statistics engine. Experiment configurations (multivariate options, flags, segments) are exposed to agents through the official MCP server and the Admin API, which claims dashboard parity. However, the evidence never shows experiment results or statistics being exposed programmatically, since the MCP description lists only flags, segments, multivariate options and release workflows, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP access to experiment results and Bayesian outputs, any result-summary or decision-support endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents reading experiment outcomes.
